create_BufferedS3Reader: create a BufferedS3Reader to read data from an S3 path using an S3StorageService
use_BufferedS3Reader_seek: use the BufferedS3Reader seek method to move the cursor to a specific index in buffered data
use_BufferedS3Reader_read: use the BufferedS3Reader read method to read a specified number of characters from the buffer
use_BufferedS3Reader_copy_to_local: use the BufferedS3Reader copy_to_local method to write buffered S3 data to a temporary local file
create_BufferedS3Writer: create a BufferedS3Writer to buffer string data and write it to an S3 path on context exit
